Vendored from https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp release tag v1.9.1.

Only the following directories were kept (examples/, tests/, bindings/, models/,
samples/, coreml/, openvino/, docs, and the upstream build scripts were dropped):
  - ggml/            (full ggml tensor library — built via add_subdirectory in
                       ../../CMakeLists.txt with all GPU backends forced OFF)
  - include/whisper.h
  - src/whisper.cpp, src/whisper-arch.h

Do not hand-edit files under this directory. To upgrade, re-download the release
zip and replace these three paths wholesale, then re-check ../../CMakeLists.txt
against upstream's src/CMakeLists.txt for any new source files added to the
`whisper` target.
